gloss: secret savings; a hidden stash of money

definitions.gloss: secret savings; a hidden stash; nest egg kept from one's family
definitions.explanation: Money set aside little by little and kept hidden, typically by one spouse from the other or from the rest of the household.

examples.japanese: へそくり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貯|た}める→貯める：27801_tameru⟧。
⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧へそくり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: My mother went on a trip with her secret savings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大掃除|おおそうじ}→大掃除：08347_oosouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していたら→する：00392_suru⟧、{本|ほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧へそくり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}てきた→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧。
examples.english: While we were doing the big cleaning, my father's secret stash turned up between the pages of a book.

notes:
Often written {臍繰|へそく}り; the usual explanation is money saved from spinning hemp thread ({綜麻|へそ}), not the navel (⟦{臍|へそ}→臍：02247_heso⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- へそくり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貯|た}める→貯める：27801_tameru⟧: to put money aside secretly
- へそくり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}す→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧: to hide one's stash
- へそくり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ばれる→ばれる：06721_bareru⟧: to have one's secret savings found out
